summary.en: First half of the Han dynasty, founded by Liu Bang with its capital at Chang'an. It consolidated the imperial system, adopted Confucian statecraft and pushed into the Western Regions before Wang Mang usurped the throne.
summary.zh: 刘邦所建汉朝前期，都长安。巩固郡县帝制、独尊儒术并经营西域，至王莽篡位而中断。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
班固《汉书》卷1–12 帝纪
Britannica: Han dynasty

summary.en: Short-lived dynasty proclaimed by the regent Wang Mang. His land, slave and currency reforms modelled on the classics caused upheaval, and the Red Eyebrows and Lülin uprisings ended it when Chang'an fell in 23.
summary.zh: 外戚王莽代汉所建王朝。托古改制推行王田、私属与币制改革，引发动荡，赤眉、绿林起义后于23年长安城破而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
班固《汉书》卷99 王莽传
Britannica: Wang Mang

note: Jiangshan-map dates the abdication of Ruzi Ying to 8 CE; Wang Mang took the throne in the 12th month of Chushi 1, i.e. January 9 CE, which Wikidata follows.

summary.en: Restored Han dynasty founded by Liu Xiu (Emperor Guangwu) with its capital at Luoyang. It saw the arrival of Buddhism, papermaking and Ban Chao's western campaigns, then declined amid eunuch–consort feuds and the Yellow Turban rising.
summary.zh: 光武帝刘秀复兴的汉朝，都洛阳。佛教东传、蔡伦造纸、班超经营西域皆在此期；后期外戚宦官交替专权，黄巾起义后走向分裂。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
范晔《后汉书》卷1–9 帝纪
Britannica: Han dynasty

note: Wikidata starts Eastern Han in 23 (fall of Wang Mang); Jiangshan-map and the Hou Hanshu date the restoration to Liu Xiu's accession in 25 (Jianwu 1), used here.

summary.en: Northern and strongest of the Three Kingdoms, founded when Cao Pi accepted the abdication of the last Han emperor. It introduced the nine-rank system, conquered Shu in 263, and was itself usurped by the Sima clan.
summary.zh: 三国中最强的北方政权，曹丕受汉献帝禅让而建，都洛阳。行九品官人法，263年灭蜀，终为司马氏所代。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷1–4 魏书 帝纪
资治通鉴 卷69 魏纪一

note: Jiangshan-map and Wikidata both end Wei in 265 (Xianxi 2, 12th month); in the Julian calendar the abdication fell in February 266.

summary.en: Three Kingdoms state in Sichuan founded by Liu Bei, who claimed the Han succession. Under chancellor Zhuge Liang it pacified the south and launched repeated northern campaigns, before surrendering to Wei forces under Deng Ai in 263.
summary.zh: 刘备于成都称帝所建，以承汉统自居。丞相诸葛亮南征北伐，263年邓艾兵临成都，后主刘禅出降。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷32–33 蜀书 先主传、后主传
资治通鉴 卷69 魏纪一 黄初二年

summary.en: Three Kingdoms state of the lower Yangtze, built by the Sun family. Sun Quan ruled from Wuchang, then Jianye (Nanjing) after proclaiming himself emperor in 229; Wu developed the south and its navy before falling to Jin in 280.
summary.zh: 孙氏据江东所建政权。孙权先都武昌，229年称帝后迁建业；开发江南、经营水师，280年为西晋所灭。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
陈寿《三国志》卷47 吴书二 吴主传
资治通鉴 卷71 魏纪三 太和三年

note: Sun Quan became King of Wu in 222 and emperor in 229; 222 is used as the start, as in Britannica and Jiangshan-map (Wikidata uses 229).

summary.en: Dynasty of the Sima clan that replaced Wei and reunified China by conquering Wu in 280. Enfeoffed princes fought the War of the Eight Princes; Xiongnu forces then sacked Luoyang (311) and Chang'an (316).
summary.zh: 司马炎代魏所建，280年灭吴统一。宗室诸王混战成八王之乱，匈奴汉赵先后攻陷洛阳（311）与长安（316）。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
房玄龄等《晋书》卷3–5 帝纪
Britannica: Jin dynasty (265–420)

note: Sima Yan's accession is dated 265 (Taishi 1) by Jiangshan-map and Wikidata; in the Julian calendar it fell in February 266.

summary.en: First of the Sixteen Kingdoms, founded by the Xiongnu noble Liu Yuan, who claimed the Han name. His successors captured Luoyang and Chang'an and ended the Western Jin; Liu Yao renamed the state Zhao and was destroyed by Shi Le.
summary.zh: 十六国之首，匈奴刘渊以汉为号起兵。其后攻陷洛阳、长安灭西晋；刘曜改国号赵，迁都长安，终为石勒所灭。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
房玄龄等《晋书》卷101–103 载记 刘元海、刘聪、刘曜
资治通鉴 卷85 晋纪七 永兴元年

summary.en: Sixteen Kingdoms state founded by the Jie general Shi Le, who destroyed the Han-Zhao and dominated north China. Shi Hu moved the capital to Ye; after his death the Ran Min massacre destroyed the dynasty.
summary.zh: 羯人石勒所建，灭汉赵后统一北方大部。石虎迁都邺城，其死后诸子争立，冉闵夺权诛石氏而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
房玄龄等《晋书》卷104–107 载记 石勒、石季龙
资治通鉴 卷91 晋纪十三 太兴二年

summary.en: Jin court re-established south of the Yangtze by Sima Rui after the fall of the north, ruling from Jiankang in partnership with great émigré clans such as the Wang and Xie. It repelled Former Qin at the Fei River and was ended by Liu Yu.
summary.zh: 西晋亡后司马睿在建康重建的晋室，与王、谢等门阀共治。淝水之战击退前秦，终由刘裕代晋建宋。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
房玄龄等《晋书》卷6–10 帝纪
资治通鉴 卷90 晋纪十二 建武元年

summary.en: Di-led Sixteen Kingdoms state centred on Chang'an. Fu Jian and his minister Wang Meng unified north China by 376, but defeat at the Fei River in 383 shattered the empire.
summary.zh: 氐族苻氏所建，都长安。苻坚任王猛，376年统一北方；383年淝水惨败后迅速瓦解。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
房玄龄等《晋书》卷112–115 载记 苻洪、苻健、苻坚
资治通鉴 卷99 晋纪二十一 永和七年

note: Wikidata starts Former Qin in 350 (Fu Hong's claim); the Jin shu dates Fu Jian's proclamation as Heavenly King at Chang'an to 351 (Yonghe 7), Jiangshan-map's date, used here.

summary.en: Xianbei Tuoba dynasty that reunified north China in 439, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms. Emperor Xiaowen moved the capital to Luoyang and pursued sinicising reforms; the Six Garrisons revolt split it into Eastern and Western Wei.
summary.zh: 鲜卑拓跋氏所建，439年统一北方，结束十六国。孝文帝迁都洛阳推行汉化；六镇之乱后分裂为东、西魏。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
魏收《魏书》卷1–11 帝纪
Britannica: Northern Wei dynasty

note: Jiangshan-map ends Northern Wei in 534 when Emperor Xiaowu fled west; Wikidata uses 535, when he died and Western Wei was proclaimed.

summary.en: Eastern successor of the divided Northern Wei, ruled in name by Emperor Xiaojing from Ye while real power lay with Gao Huan and his sons, who replaced it with Northern Qi in 550.
summary.zh: 北魏分裂后的东部政权，都邺。孝静帝在位而权归高欢父子，550年高洋代之建北齐。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
魏收《魏书》卷12 孝静纪
李百药《北齐书》卷1–2 神武纪

summary.en: Western successor of Northern Wei, dominated by Yuwen Tai from Chang'an. Its fubing militia and the Guanzhong aristocracy laid the foundations of the Sui and Tang; it seized Sichuan and Jiangling from Liang.
summary.zh: 北魏分裂后的西部政权，宇文泰掌权，都长安。创府兵制，形成关陇集团，夺取萧梁巴蜀与江陵，为隋唐奠基。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
令狐德棻等《周书》卷1–2 文帝纪
李延寿《北史》卷5 魏本纪五

summary.en: Dynasty of the Gao family that succeeded Eastern Wei, ruling the rich North China Plain from Ye with Jinyang as secondary capital. Court violence weakened it, and Northern Zhou conquered it in 577.
summary.zh: 高洋代东魏所建，都邺，以晋阳为别都，据华北富庶之地。宫廷屡生残杀，577年为北周所灭。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
李百药《北齐书》卷4–8 帝纪
资治通鉴 卷163 梁纪十九 大宝元年

summary.en: Dynasty of the Yuwen clan that replaced Western Wei. Emperor Wu suppressed Buddhism and Daoism to strengthen the state and conquered Northern Qi in 577; his chancellor Yang Jian took the throne in 581 as founder of Sui.
summary.zh: 宇文觉代西魏所建，都长安。周武帝禁佛道以强国，577年灭北齐；581年外戚杨坚受禅建隋。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
令狐德棻等《周书》卷3–8 帝纪
资治通鉴 卷167 陈纪一 永定元年

summary.en: First of the Southern Dynasties, founded by the general Liu Yu after his northern conquests. The Yuanjia era of Emperor Wen was prosperous, but failed northern campaigns and fratricide weakened it until Xiao Daocheng seized power.
summary.zh: 南朝第一代，刘裕北伐立功后代晋所建，都建康。宋文帝元嘉之治较为繁荣；北伐失利、宗室相残，终为萧道成所代。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
沈约《宋书》卷1–10 本纪
资治通鉴 卷119 宋纪一 永初元年

summary.en: Short Southern Dynasty of the Xiao family founded by Xiao Daocheng. Purges of princes under Emperor Ming and the misrule of Xiao Baojuan led the Yongzhou governor Xiao Yan to rise at Xiangyang and found Liang.
summary.zh: 萧道成代宋所建南朝政权，都建康。齐明帝大诛宗室，东昏侯昏暴，雍州刺史萧衍起兵襄阳而代之。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
萧子显《南齐书》卷1–8 本纪
资治通鉴 卷135 齐纪一 建元元年

summary.en: Southern Dynasty founded by Xiao Yan (Emperor Wu), whose nearly fifty-year reign was a high point of southern culture and Buddhist patronage. The rebellion of Hou Jing devastated Jiankang in 548–552 and the dynasty never recovered.
summary.zh: 萧衍所建南朝政权，都建康。梁武帝在位近五十年，文教昌盛、崇信佛教；侯景之乱残破江南，梁室自此不振。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
姚思廉《梁书》卷1–6 本纪
资治通鉴 卷145 梁纪一 天监元年

note: Wikidata ends the Liang in 587, counting the Western Liang rump state at Jiangling; Jiangshan-map ends it with Chen Baxian's usurpation in 557, used here.

summary.en: Last of the Southern Dynasties, founded by Chen Baxian after he suppressed Hou Jing's rebellion. Confined to the lower Yangtze, it fell in 589 when Sui armies crossed the river and captured Chen Shubao in Jiankang.
summary.zh: 陈霸先平侯景之乱后受梁禅所建，都建康。疆域局促江南，589年隋军渡江攻入建康，俘陈后主而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
姚思廉《陈书》卷1–6 本纪
资治通鉴 卷177 隋纪一 开皇九年

summary.en: Dynasty that reunified China in 589 after nearly three centuries of division. It created the Three Departments and Six Ministries, the first examinations and the Grand Canal, but costly Korean wars under Emperor Yang provoked its collapse.
summary.zh: 杨坚代北周所建，589年灭陈结束近三百年分裂。确立三省六部、首创科举、开凿大运河；隋炀帝三征高句丽耗尽民力而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
魏征等《隋书》卷1–5 帝纪
Britannica: Sui dynasty

summary.en: Dynasty of the Li family whose cosmopolitan capital Chang'an was the largest city of its age. Early Tang extended protectorates across Central Asia; after the An Lushan rebellion regional governors gained power until Zhu Wen ended the dynasty in 907.
summary.zh: 李渊所建王朝，都长安，为当时世界最大都会。前期设都护府经营西域，安史之乱后藩镇割据，907年为朱温所篡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
刘昫等《旧唐书》卷1–20 本纪
Britannica: Tang dynasty

summary.en: Interregnum of the Tang in which Wu Zetian ruled as emperor of her own Zhou dynasty, the only woman to do so in Chinese history, governing from Luoyang, renamed the Divine Capital. The Shenlong coup of 705 restored the Tang.
summary.zh: 武则天改唐为周自立为帝，以洛阳为神都，是中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。705年神龙政变后复唐国号。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
刘昫等《旧唐书》卷6 则天皇后本纪
资治通鉴 卷204 唐纪二十 天授元年

summary.en: Empire of the Yarlung dynasty unified by Songtsen Gampo, who married the Tang princess Wencheng. At its height it took the Tarim garrisons and the Hexi Corridor and briefly occupied Chang'an (763); it fragmented after Langdarma's death.
summary.zh: 松赞干布统一青藏高原所建王朝，与唐和亲迎娶文成公主。鼎盛时夺取安西四镇与河西，763年一度攻入长安；朗达玛死后分裂。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
刘昫等《旧唐书》卷196 吐蕃传
Britannica: Tibet – History

note: Start (c. 618) and early reign dates are approximate; Tibetan and Chinese chronologies differ.

capital.zh: 太和城，后迁阳苴咩城（大理）

summary.en: Kingdom of the Erhai basin in Yunnan formed when Piluoge united the six zhao with Tang backing in 738. It later allied with Tibet, defeated Tang armies in the 750s and raided Sichuan and Annam before its fall in 902.
summary.zh: 唐册封皮逻阁统一六诏所建，都太和城，后迁阳苴咩城。曾附吐蕃、天宝年间大败唐军，屡掠巴蜀与安南，902年亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
欧阳修等《新唐书》卷222 南蛮传 南诏
Britannica: Nanzhao

note: Piluoge reigned as a zhao chief from 728; the unified kingdom with Tang investiture dates from 738.

summary.en: First of the Five Dynasties, founded when the warlord Zhu Wen forced the last Tang emperor to abdicate. It fought a long war with the Shatuo of Hedong and fell when Li Cunxu captured Kaifeng in 923.
summary.zh: 五代第一朝，朱温篡唐所建，都汴州开封。与河东沙陀晋王长期争战，923年李存勖袭破汴州而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
薛居正等《旧五代史》卷1–10 梁书
资治通鉴 卷266 后梁纪一 开平元年

summary.en: Five Dynasties regime of the Shatuo Li family, who claimed Tang descent. Li Cunxu destroyed Later Liang and Former Shu but died in a mutiny; Shi Jingtang overthrew the dynasty with Khitan help.
summary.zh: 沙陀李存勖称帝所建，以承唐统，都洛阳。灭后梁、前蜀，庄宗死于兵变；石敬瑭借契丹兵灭之。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
薛居正等《旧五代史》卷27–48 唐书
资治通鉴 卷272 后唐纪一 同光元年

note: Jiangshan-map and Wikidata end Later Tang in 936 (Qingtai 3); Luoyang fell on 11 January 937 in the Julian calendar.

summary.en: Five Dynasties regime founded by Shi Jingtang, who ceded the Sixteen Prefectures to the Khitan in return for their support. When his successor defied the Liao, the Khitan captured Kaifeng and ended the dynasty.
summary.zh: 石敬瑭割燕云十六州、称儿于契丹而建，都开封。出帝石重贵对契丹称孙不称臣，947年契丹攻入开封而亡。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
薛居正等《旧五代史》卷75–85 晋书
资治通鉴 卷280 后晋纪一 天福元年

summary.en: Shortest of the Five Dynasties, founded by the Hedong governor Liu Zhiyuan after the Khitan withdrew from Kaifeng. His son Liu Chengyou provoked Guo Wei into rebellion and was killed in 951.
summary.zh: 河东节度使刘知远乘契丹北撤而建，都开封，为五代最短。隐帝刘承祐猜忌郭威，951年兵变身死。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
薛居正等《旧五代史》卷99–103 汉书
资治通鉴 卷286 后汉纪一 天福十二年

summary.en: Last of the Five Dynasties, founded by Guo Wei. His adopted son Chai Rong (Shizong) reformed the army, took the Huainan lands from Southern Tang and attacked the Liao, preparing the way for Song reunification.
summary.zh: 郭威所建，都开封。养子周世宗柴荣整军、三征南唐取江北淮南、北伐契丹，为宋朝统一奠基。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
薛居正等《旧五代史》卷110–120 周书
资治通鉴 卷290 后周纪一 广顺元年

summary.en: Largest of the Ten Kingdoms, founded by Li Bian in Jinling after he replaced the Yang Wu. It annexed Min and Chu, lost Huainan to Later Zhou, and surrendered to Song in 975–976; its last ruler Li Yu is famed for his ci poetry.
summary.zh: 李昪代杨吴所建，都金陵，为十国最强。灭闽、楚，失淮南于后周；975年金陵城破，后主李煜以词名世。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
马令《南唐书》
资治通鉴 卷281 后晋纪二 天福二年

note: Jinling fell in the 11th month of Kaibao 8 (late 975); Li Yu formally surrendered at Kaifeng in early 976, the end date Wikidata uses. Jiangshan-map uses 975.

summary.en: Coastal Ten Kingdoms state of the Qian family centred on Hangzhou. Qian Liu built the Qiantang seawall and promoted trade and Buddhism; Qian Chu peacefully submitted his territory to the Song in 978.
summary.zh: 钱镠所建，都杭州。筑钱塘捍海石塘，兴商崇佛、保境安民；978年钱俶纳土归宋。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
欧阳修《新五代史》卷67 吴越世家
Britannica: Wuyue

summary.en: Khitan empire founded by Abaoji that ruled Manchuria, Mongolia and the Sixteen Prefectures through a dual northern-southern administration with five capitals. The Chanyuan treaty fixed peace with Song; the Jurchen Jin destroyed it in 1125.
summary.zh: 契丹耶律阿保机所建，行南北面官制、设五京，据有东北、漠北与燕云。澶渊之盟后与宋长期和平，1125年为金所灭。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《辽史》卷1–30 本纪
Britannica: Liao dynasty

summary.en: First half of the Song dynasty, founded by Zhao Kuangyin at Kaifeng. It reunified China proper, subordinated the military to civil officials, and saw printing, paper money and an urban economic boom before the Jurchen sacked Kaifeng in 1127.
summary.zh: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变所建，都东京开封。统一中原与江南，重文抑武；印刷术、交子与城市经济繁荣，1127年靖康之变亡于金。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷1–23 本纪
Britannica: Song dynasty

summary.en: Tangut state proclaimed by Li Yuanhao at Xingqing, controlling the Ordos and the Hexi Corridor. It created its own script, fought and traded with Song, Liao and Jin, and was destroyed by the Mongols in 1227.
summary.zh: 党项李元昊于兴庆府称帝所建，据河套与河西走廊。创制西夏文，与宋、辽、金或战或和，1227年为蒙古所灭。

sources.title: Jiangshan Atlas 江山时序 (jiangshan-map, GPL-3.0)
脱脱等《宋史》卷485–486 夏国传
Britannica: Xi Xia

summary.en: Jurchen dynasty founded by Wanyan Aguda, which destroyed the Liao in 1125 and the Northern Song in 1127, then ruled north China from Zhongdu. Mongol attacks drove it to Kaifeng, and it fell at Caizhou in 1234.
summary.zh: 女真完颜阿骨打所建，1125年灭辽、1127年灭北宋，迁都中都统治华北。蒙古进攻下南迁汴京，1234年亡于蔡州。

Britannica: Jin dynasty (1115–1234)

summary.en: Song court re-established in the south by Zhao Gou after the Jingkang disaster, with Lin'an as its "temporary" capital. Despite military pressure from Jin and then the Mongols, its commercial economy and Neo-Confucian scholarship flourished until defeat at Yamen in 1279.
summary.zh: 靖康之变后赵构在南方重建的宋室，以临安为行在。虽受金、蒙古压迫，商业与理学繁盛，1279年崖山海战后灭亡。

Britannica: Song dynasty

summary.en: Buddhist kingdom of the Duan family in Yunnan, founded by Duan Siping in 937 as successor to Nanzhao. It traded horses with Song and was conquered by Kublai's Mongol army, which crossed the Jinsha River in 1253.
summary.zh: 段思平所建云南政权，承南诏故地，崇信佛教，与宋互市战马。1253年忽必烈革囊渡金沙江灭之。

note: Wikidata ends Dali in 1253; Jiangshan-map uses 1254, when Duan Xingzhi was captured after the 1253 Mongol campaign. Ruler dates are approximate.

summary.en: Mongol dynasty proclaimed by Kublai Khan in 1271, which conquered the Southern Song and ruled all China from Dadu with Shangdu as summer capital. It created the branch-secretariat provinces and was driven north by the Ming in 1368.
summary.zh: 忽必烈1271年定国号大元，灭南宋统一全国，以大都、上都为两都，创行省制度。1368年明军攻克大都，元廷北迁。

Britannica: Yuan dynasty

summary.en: Han Chinese dynasty founded by Zhu Yuanzhang at Nanjing; the Yongle Emperor moved the capital to Beijing and sent Zheng He's fleets abroad. The Ming rebuilt the Great Wall and fell when Li Zicheng took Beijing in 1644.
summary.zh: 朱元璋于应天所建，永乐帝迁都北京并遣郑和下西洋。修筑九边长城，1644年李自成攻陷北京而亡。

Britannica: Ming dynasty

summary.en: Manchu dynasty proclaimed by Hong Taiji in 1636 as successor to Nurhaci's Later Jin. It entered Beijing in 1644, expanded to Xinjiang, Tibet and Taiwan under Kangxi and Qianlong, then faced Western wars and rebellion until the 1911 revolution.
summary.zh: 皇太极1636年改后金为大清，1644年入关定都北京。康雍乾时期版图扩至新疆、西藏与台湾，近代屡遭列强侵略与内乱，1912年清帝退位。

Britannica: Qing dynasty

note: The dynastic name Qing dates from 1636 (Hong Taiji), which Wikidata uses; Jiangshan-map's Qing period begins with the entry into Beijing in 1644.

summary.en: Rebel theocratic state led by Hong Xiuquan, who claimed to be Christ's younger brother. Rising at Jintian in Guangxi, it held the lower Yangtze from Nanjing for over a decade before the Xiang Army took Tianjing in 1864.
summary.zh: 洪秀全以拜上帝会起事所建，1851年金田起义，1853年定都天京，据长江中下游十余年，1864年天京陷于湘军。

summary.en: Republic founded after the Xinhai Revolution. The Beiyang government in Beijing fragmented into warlord cliques until the Nationalist Northern Expedition (1926–28) made Nanjing the capital; after war with Japan and civil war, the government retreated to Taiwan in 1949.
summary.zh: 辛亥革命后建立。北洋政府时期军阀割据，1928年国民党北伐后定都南京；历经抗日战争与内战，1949年国民政府迁往台湾。

summary.en: Puppet state set up by Japan in Manchuria after the Mukden Incident, with the deposed Qing emperor Puyi as figurehead. It was dissolved after the Soviet invasion and Japan's surrender in August 1945.
summary.zh: 九一八事变后日本在东北扶植的傀儡政权，以溥仪为元首，都新京。1945年苏军进入东北、日本投降后瓦解。

summary.en: State proclaimed by Mao Zedong in Beijing on 1 October 1949 after the Communist victory in the civil war. After the Mao era, the reform and opening policy launched in 1978 transformed it into a major world economy.
summary.zh: 1949年10月1日毛泽东在北京宣告成立。毛泽东时代之后，1978年起改革开放，发展为世界主要经济体。
